class.name: HTMLStyleElement
class.brief_description: A stylesheet written directly in the document.
class.description: Represents [code]<style>[/code]. Changing its text discards previously edited CSSOM rules and resets the sheet's runtime disabled state. Changing [member media] or [member disabled] preserves the associated stylesheet ID and rules.

method.name: get_stylesheet_id
method.description: Returns the layout's CSSOM ID for the associated stylesheet, or [code]0[/code] if there is no associated sheet. Use the ID with [method HTMLLayout.get_css_rules], [method HTMLLayout.insert_rule], and [method HTMLLayout.delete_rule].

members.member: Disables the associated sheet at runtime. With no associated sheet, this property reads [code]false[/code] and writes have no effect.
The media query list that controls when the stylesheet applies.
The associated stylesheet, or [code]null[/code] when no stylesheet is associated.
The original CSS text of the element. Read edited CSSOM rules using [method get_stylesheet_id] and [method HTMLLayout.get_css_rules].
The declared MIME type of the inline stylesheet. An empty value defaults to [code]text/css[/code].
